observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show a pair of chrome-faced headlight assemblies with amber turn-signal sections and a dark red/maroon trim strip, lying on a stone/tile floor.
No tail lights ('back lights') are visible in any of the three photos despite being mentioned in the seller's text.
No brand logo, part number, or 'Honda' marking is legible on the plastic housings in any photo.
A watermark reading 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' appears across photos 0-2, indicating a reseller/shop watermark, not a manufacturer mark.

A second, partially visible headlight (different shape) appears at the right edge of photo 0 and bottom of photo 2, suggesting multiple different models stocked together, not necessarily the one being sold.
